CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_period_close_health(p_entity_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_period text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_data_environment text DEFAULT 'production'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_env text := coalesce(nullif(p_data_environment, ''), 'production');
  v_period text := nullif(p_period, '');
  expected_count int := 0;
  record_count int := 0;
  missing_record_count int := 0;
  closed_count int := 0;
  open_count int := 0;
begin
  with expected_months as (
    select distinct
      coalesce(nullif(le.data_environment, ''), 'production') as data_environment,
      coalesce(nullif(le.entity_id, ''), 'UNKNOWN') as entity_id,
      to_char(le.entry_date, 'YYYY-MM') as period_month
    from public.ledger_entries le
    where le.entry_date is not null

    union

    select distinct
      coalesce(nullif(v.data_environment, ''), 'production'),
      coalesce(nullif(v.entity_id, ''), 'UNKNOWN'),
      to_char(coalesce(v.voucher_date, v.created_at::date), 'YYYY-MM')
    from public.vouchers v
    where coalesce(v.voucher_date, v.created_at::date) is not null
  ),
  scoped_expected as (
    select *
    from expected_months
    where data_environment = v_env
      and (p_entity_id is null or entity_id = p_entity_id)
      and (v_period is null or period_month = v_period)
  ),
  scoped_records as (
    select *
    from public.accounting_period_close_records r
    where r.data_environment = v_env
      and (p_entity_id is null or r.entity_id = p_entity_id)
      and (v_period is null or r.period_month = v_period)
  )
  select
    (select count(*)::int from scoped_expected),
    (select count(*)::int from scoped_records),
    (
      select count(*)::int
      from scoped_expected e
      where not exists (
        select 1
        from scoped_records r
        where r.entity_id = e.entity_id
          and r.period_month = e.period_month
      )
    ),
    (select count(*)::int from scoped_records where status = 'closed'),
    (select count(*)::int from scoped_records where status <> 'closed')
  into expected_count, record_count, missing_record_count, closed_count, open_count;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', missing_record_count = 0,
    'status', case
      when missing_record_count > 0 then 'missing_period_records'
      when open_count > 0 then 'records_exist_pending_close'
      else 'closed'
    end,
    'data_environment', v_env,
    'entity_id', p_entity_id,
    'period', v_period,
    'expected_period_count', expected_count,
    'period_record_count', record_count,
    'missing_record_count', missing_record_count,
    'closed_count', closed_count,
    'open_pending_close_count', open_count
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finance_bill_withdraw_applicant_v1(p_bill_ids text[], p_idempotency_key text, p_comment text, p_expected_steps jsonb, p_data_environment text DEFAULT 'production'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET lock_timeout TO '5s'
AS $function$
begin
  return private.finance_income_withdraw_applicant_v1(
    'bill', p_bill_ids, p_idempotency_key, p_comment,
    p_expected_steps, p_data_environment
  );
end;
$function$
